title: [26/02/2022] Wool production
prompt: The picture shows the process of making wool. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagram illustrates the sequence of steps involved in producing wool products from sheep.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: The process consists of several stages, beginning with sheep rearing and culminating in the manufacture of end products.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: The process begins with the rearing of sheep, followed by wool shearing, where farmers remove the wool from the animals. The raw wool then undergoes a cleaning process to remove dirt and impurities. Following this, the wool is dried using specialized equipment, which prepares it for the next stage. Subsequently, the dried wool goes through a carding process, where it is combed and aligned, producing both tufts of wool and strings.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: While the strings can be recycled, the tufts of wool are placed in storage. After that, the stored wool undergoes yarn spinning, where it is transformed into balls of yarn. Finally, these balls of yarn can either be used for knitting or be made into finished products such as jackets or carpets.
